paragraphs: I turn business needs into clear, testable requirements. I gather them through stakeholder interviews and workshops, then document them as BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.

I compare AS-IS and TO-BE workflows, run gap and impact analysis, and use SQL and Excel to validate data and reconcile reporting discrepancies. I also analyze REST API interfaces and document field-level mappings and validation rules.

I currently work as a Knowledge Management Analyst at Abbott Laboratories. There I review enterprise knowledge repositories and SOPs, standardize taxonomies and metadata, and track content freshness through governance reports.
